mapper.select: select id, publishDate, address, storeId, status, deliveryGuyId, note, userId, deliveryRate from ticket
select id, publishDate, address, storeId, status, deliveryGuyId, note, userId, deliveryRate from ticket where id = #{id}
select id, publishDate, address, storeId, status, deliveryGuyId, note, userId, deliveryRate from ticket where storeId = #{storeId}
select id, publishDate, address, storeId, status, deliveryGuyId, note, userId, deliveryRate from ticket where deliveryGuyId = #{deliveryGuyId}
select id, publishDate, address, storeId, status, deliveryGuyId, note, userId, deliveryRate from ticket where userId = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into ticket(publishDate, address, storeId, status, deliveryGuyId, note, userId, deliveryRate) values(#{publishDate}, #{address}, #{storeId}, #{status}, #{deliveryGuyId}, #{note}, #{userId}, #{deliveryRate})
mapper.update: update ticket set publishDate = #{publishDate}, address = #{address}, storeId = #{storeId}, status = #{status}, deliveryGuyId = #{deliveryGuyId}, note = #{note}, userId = #{userId}, deliveryRate = #{deliveryRate} where id = #{id}
